##### Project general facts
 
Hatimi is a refined residential development set within Dubai Islands, offering a contemporary vision of elevated coastal living. The architecture reflects a balance between modern design and natural surroundings, with elegant forms, open spaces, and a seamless integration into the island’s vibrant environment. Surrounded by curated retail, dining, and cultural experiences, the project is designed as part of a dynamic lifestyle destination where every detail contributes to a sense of sophistication, energy, and connection.

The lifestyle at Hatimi is defined by a comprehensive range of amenities that support well-being, leisure, and social interaction. Residents benefit from access to landscaped green spaces, chic clubhouses, wellness facilities, and thoughtfully designed communal areas that encourage both relaxation and activity. Within the wider Dubai Islands setting, beaches, marinas, sports clubs, and lifestyle destinations further enhance the experience, creating a unique balance between resort-style living and urban convenience.

Interiors are delivered fully finished with modern, high-quality materials, complemented by advanced smart home technology accessible via an AI-powered mobile app. This system allows seamless control over lighting, climate, and security, while energy-efficient solutions enhance everyday comfort. Kitchens come fully equipped, and all residences are fully furnished, offering a turnkey living experience that combines contemporary design, functionality, and effortless convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a unique complex of five islands located north of Dubai city, offering a diverse island life and vacation-inspired lifestyle. Here you will find luxury resort offerings, village centers with a variety of services and activities, luxury health and sports complexes, as well as beautiful beaches for water sports and green areas for outdoor recreation.

This modern residential development offers over 50 kilometers of stunning waterfront homes and hotels that create an idyllic setting, combining sandy shores, world-class amenities and water edges with the mainland via the spectacular Infinity Bridge.

Residents can enjoy beautiful residences that include apartments and villas. Extensive amenities include stunning swimming pools, green garden terraces and pristine beaches.
